text_block_list.text:
Summer camp has started.
An important season for 
horse girl.
I've been doing everything I can to 
make sure no time is wasted.

A high-intensity training menu packed full
of 
training.
Followed with icing on the top a 
massage preparations.

The training itself proceeds smoothly, 
Since we share what we need to do with each
other. 
Even so―

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ――Ha.

I secretly fist pump for visible training
results. 
I'm happy that I can do my work as a
trainer 
without problem.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Thank you again for your assistance
today. 
Now, I will go and change my clothes.

After the training is over,
there are still things I can do.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, we're going to the festival,
right? 
I wonder if they are serving carrot roast
again this year?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I should have eaten a little
less for dinner. 
I tend to overeat when I eat out.

The training camp schedule is halfway over,
and 
a summer festival will be held nearby
today.

Many horse girl go out happily,
but Daiichi Ruby 
will probably stay at the training camp.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ……Trainer-san?
choice_data_list: I've prepared a place for study fo...

text_block_list.text:
I tried to prepare an environment that is
as close as 
possible to the school environment for her
study time.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
……There was such a quiet place in the training
camp. 
And even desks and lights.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ……Thank you for your consideration.

Do～on,
the sound of fireworks can be heard from
afar. 
It's almost time for the festival to end.

However, Daiichi Ruby,
who is concentrating, 
doesn't seem to be able to hear the outside
sounds.

When it finally time for break,
I say the words 
I had prepared before.
choice_data_list: Why don't we go for a little walk?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ……Understood.

On the way,
we pass by people returning from the 
festival.
I think "Are you really okay you didn't
go?", but I decide to not say it.

Some people may think that studying while
everyone 
else is enjoying the festivities is too much.
But―

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Tranquility……

On an empty beach,
we stood side by side looking up at 
the stars in the sky.
The sound of the sea breeze feel 
pleasant to my ears.
choice_data_list: I heard the stars here are beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Indeed, it is a beautiful view.

Daiichi Ruby stay silent after saying that,
but that's fine. 
Giving her Just a few minutes of distraction
after training camp,
that's the only thing I can do for her.

She continues her study on her own
volition. 
Telling her to take more rest or to play
around 
like eveyone else is not the right thing to
do.

Born as a member of the "Noble family",
she never averts 
her eyes from the heavy responsibility.
All I can do as 
her trainer is to support her with all my
might.

Summer constellations twinkle in the night
sky. 
Shining red in the sky is the heart of the
scorpion - Antares.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: …………Ah, as expected.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ……Scorpion's Fire……

I thought I heard something from her,
but before 
I could confirm it,
Daiichi Ruby's appearance returned to
normal.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
The night breeze cleared my head. 
I'm going to go back and prepare for tomorrow's
training.

As soon as she said it,
Daiichi Ruby turned on her heel. 
Perhaps this walk too was not necessary for
her.

Did I cause trouble with my unnecessary
suggestion? 
I was worried about that…

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: …I would like to be like that too.

Through the small back,
I heard that one sentence.

I wasn't sure if she was referring to the
star 
that she wanted to show me. It's just―

I feel like we got closer just a little
bit. 
It was such a joyful evening.
